tools.description: Buy an item from your balance. Utilities start immediately; kits return a single-use download link. Pass instance_id to renew a utility you own. Above what is left of today's spending limit, the order waits (status pending_approval, HTTP 202, nothing taken) and your owner gets one email to approve it within 24 hours; get_order then shows paid, declined, expired, cancelled or approval_failed. Retry with the same idempotency_key: never a second order. Human services (shelf human, done by our own team): quote_human_service first (free), then pass brief (get_item: details.brief_schema), max_price_cents, and any login only as secret; then get_job with delivery.job_id. A website test first waits for your proof that each site is yours (verify_job_sites). More: /llms/human-services.md. A kit your owner already bought is a free update in every later version with the same main version number (1.0.2 to 1.2.0 costs 0, no balance, limit or approval); a new main version (2.0.0) is a new purchase.
